sources.read_scope: Full HTML method: Sections 3.2, 4.1, 4.2; Eqs. 4-8; Appendix D; Appendix F.
sources.mechanism: Query magnitude multiplied by key quantization sensitivity ranks key channels for BF16/UINT4/UINT2; values use per-token 2-bit quantization and statistics update periodically.

sources.read_scope: Full HTML method: Sections 3-3.2 (query-adaptive reader), Appendix B.2-B.3 (attention-guided precision and query access), Tables 2-3.
sources.mechanism: A progressive stored code supports query-selected key prefixes followed by attention-selected value prefixes under separate retained and fetched bit budgets.

sources.title: KV Cache Compression Through the Lens of Transform Coding
sources.read_scope: Full HTML method: Sections II-B, IV and V-V-A; Table I; Eqs. 6-7; Appendix method references.
sources.mechanism: Whitening/SVD transforms and reverse water-filling allocate bits using attention-aware distortion from calibration statistics.
sources.difference: Per-token transformed channel allocation from calibration versus prompt-conditioned VLM window ranking.
sources.short_source_span: allocate bits over a calibration set to minimize attention-aware distortion

sources.title: No Token Left Behind: Reliable KV Cache Compression via Importance-Aware Mixed Precision Quantization
sources.read_scope: Full HTML method: Sections 3.1-3.2; Eqs. 1-4; Table 2; prefill outlier-balancing discussion.
sources.mechanism: Important KV pairs stay high precision while less important pairs remain low precision; a query/key outlier-aware prefill balancer reduces low-bit error.
sources.difference: Token/pair importance and outlier balancing versus proposed window-level ranking.
sources.short_source_span: retaining a minimal amount of information through the process of low-precision quantization

sources.title: Spend Bits Where Queries Look: KV Cache Vector Quantization with Attention-Preserving Transforms
sources.read_scope: Full HTML method: Sections 3-4; Eqs. 3-5; Sections 5 and Appendix B; Theorem 2 on fixed-rate grouping.
sources.mechanism: NOVA-KV derives calibration-based key/value transforms from attention-product distortion and applies fixed-width vector quantization with equal-volume grouping.
sources.difference: Attention-product distortion and fixed-rate VQ alter the representation/quantizer, whereas the proposal changes only prefill window ranking and freezes WindowQuant counts.
sources.short_source_span: we formulate KV cache compression as a transform coding problem in which distortion is set to be the attention product error

sources.title: WindowQuant: Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization based on Window-Level Similarity for VLMs Inference Optimization
sources.read_scope: Full HTML/paper extract checked: Sections 3.1-3.3; Eqs. 8-11; Algorithm 1-2; first-window FP16 and reorder path.
sources.mechanism: Visual-window/text-prompt similarity assigns window precision and same-bit windows are reordered for inference.
sources.difference: The proposed experiment changes only the window ranking while freezing baseline counts and other operations.
